description.value: Ginger Beef House is a Chinese restaurant in Campbell River offering a sit-down all-you-can-eat buffet as well as takeout. The menu leans into classic Chinese-Canadian staples like ginger beef, chow mein, fried dumplings, and wonton soup. It sits along the Island Highway, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through town.
